implementation.change: Extend the SettingsClient-only node:http/node:https helper with pinned Axios 0.17.1 redirect, decompression, response-transform, rejection, and truncated-response behavior.

redirects.301_302_303: POST becomes GET; body, Content-Type, and Content-Length are removed; source-controlled credentials/target/Accept/User-Agent/Host/Connection remain.
redirects.307: POST, body, entity headers, and source-controlled headers are preserved.

response.jsonTransform: JSON.parse when possible; malformed and empty strings remain strings, matching Axios 0.17.1.
response.non2xx: Rejects with Request failed with status code N and response.status/headers/data fields.
response.truncated: Resolves bytes received at the source Node 8 Axios response boundary.

unchanged: Settings-only source-controlled initial request headers and order
NET_settings resolution and source URL construction
account/loop/transId validation and GetSettings body fields

source.execution: Exact extracted Node 8.9.4 host executable; not Docker.

candidate.workspaceResolution: Candidate-local node_modules; @phoenix/common and @phoenix/contracts resolve under this worktree.

fixture.peer: Separate loopback HTTP server for source and candidate
fixture.providerMode: Synthetic settings JSON; no deployed provider services

preExistingDifferences: Malformed JSON and empty JSON used fetch res.json rejection instead of Axios's raw-string transform.
4xx/5xx used the Phoenix Settings service error instead of Axios response status/data rejection fields.
Truncated body produced fetch TypeError terminated instead of the source partial response boundary.

regressionsRepaired: 301/302/303/307 follow-redirect method, body, and header handling

validation.workspaceResolution: Local candidate node_modules copied from the independently installed candidate; no package or shared lockfile changes.

limits: Candidate remains unverified pending root review.
Source and candidate use host Node 8.9.4 and Node 22.22.0 respectively; source image pin is provenance only for this control.
Controls use same-origin loopback redirects; cross-origin redirect credential policy, redirect loops beyond the 21-hop bound, DNS/TLS failures, timeouts, and retries remain unverified.
Provider seams are synthetic fixed functions behind a local peer; no deployed Account, Hub, Person, or Lasso service was started.
Raw response date values and runtime-specific stack text are expected to differ and are retained in the unnormalized receipt.
No main, robot, golden, comparator, shared lockfile, global HTTP client, or live service changes were made.
